messages:
Maria C: Hey team — HalYard POC needs final net handoff. Customer is multi-cloud (AWS + Azure). They want Private endpoint for perf but want TGW fallback for DR. They also reported intermittent streaming stalls. Any blockers for PrivateEndpoint + TGW fallback? Also asked for a short firewall snippet we can hand them. :wave:
Jamal R: We can do Private Endpoint (Privatelink) primary with TGW as fallback. Main asks: preserve client IP for logging, static egress IP(s) for allowlisting, and path MTU. Streaming stalls often due to MTU or TCP keepalive timeouts across the on‑prem/edge proxy.
Priya K: Quick checklist I recommend we send to customer: 1) Allow outbound to our regional NATs (see ranges below) on 443; 2) Health checks to 80/443 from our connector; 3) Keep MTU consistent (1500) or enable MSS clamping on the tunnel if ISP reduces MTU.
Priya K: Firewall example (paste to their netops):
```
# allow Redwood connector egress
ALLOW tcp FROM 10.10.0.0/16 TO 54.33.21.0/24 PORT 443  # region-us-east-1 nat pool
ALLOW tcp FROM 10.10.0.0/16 TO 52.112.45.0/24 PORT 443  # region-eu-west-1 nat pool
# health checks and metrics
ALLOW tcp FROM 10.10.0.0/16 TO 54.33.21.123 PORT 80
```
Jamal R: For AWS TGW fallback: route table rule priority should prefer interface endpoint attachment, then TGW route to egress VPC. Use route propagation for failover. Important: ensure source IP preservation on the path you want to keep — if you need preserved source, avoid NAT at the egress or use static NAT mapping.
Maria C: Can you confirm the exact NAT ranges so I can include them in the SOW? Also client asked about pricing impact if they require static egress IPs per-region for Private deployment.
Priya K: NAT ranges above are examples — final ranges depend on deployment region and will be in the handoff sheet. Pricing: static egress IP per-region is an add-on for Private (billing note). For Hosted API it's covered by egress usage but not guaranteed sticky IPs.
Alex S: Security reviewers also asked about TLS termination and certs — customer wants BYO cert for mTLS at the edge. Is that supported in Private?
Jamal R: Yes for Private deployments — we support customer-managed certs (bring-your-own CA or ACM). For hosted we can do mutual TLS to connector but BYO cert for public endpoint needs enterprise plan. I'll add the exact bullet to the security Q&A.
infra-bot: deployment-scheduler: POC connector test slot reserved 2024-06-18 14:00 UTC. Auto-notify will send logs to the thread after smoke tests.
Maria C: Great — I'll send this checklist + sample fw rules + note about MTU and keepalive to HalYard. Any last ops tips for the on-call running the POC?
Priya K: Ask them to run a quick iperf across the path and a persistent curl stream for 30s to reproduce stalls. If streaming stalls, try lowering MSS by 40 bytes on the tunnel to see if that fixes it.
Alex S: Thx — I'll add pricing caveat in the quote (static IP add-on) and attach the security Q&A entry. :+1:
